classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: Masters of weapons and armour who thrive in the thick of battle, warriors draw strength from the fury of combat itself: every blow struck and suffered feeds their Rage.
classes.designNotes: Warriors have no mana: Rage builds from the white swings you land at the end of each turn and from the blows you take, and decays out of combat. Stances, Bloodrage and the big cooldowns cost no Time, and Heroic Strike/Cleave replace your next end-of-turn swing, so a turn is a stance dance plus one or two GCD attacks: Charge and Overpower in Battle Stance, Taunt, Sunder and Revenge as the party's tank in Defensive Stance, Whirlwind, Intercept and Pummel in Berserker Stance. Arms and Fury reward big two-handers or dual wielding; Protection turns a shield into a wall.

abilities.name: Battle Stance
abilities.description: A balanced combat stance. Generates 20% less threat. Required for Charge, Overpower, Thunder Clap, Mocking Blow, Retaliation and Sweeping Strikes. Changing stance discards rage above what Tactical Mastery lets you keep.

abilities.name: Defensive Stance
abilities.description: A defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken and damage caused by 10%. Increases threat generated by 30%. Required for Taunt, Revenge, Shield Block, Shield Wall and Disarm.

abilities.name: Berserker Stance
abilities.description: An aggressive stance. Critical hit chance is increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%. Generates 20% less threat. Required for Intercept, Pummel, Whirlwind, Berserker Rage and Recklessness.

specials.behaviour: Effect special that runs before the stance's ApplyAura. If the warrior already has the target stance aura the ability cannot be used. Otherwise its rage becomes min(currentRage, keep) where keep = 5 x rank of Tactical Mastery (the talent's Special passive: value 5 per rank, 0-25; 0 without the talent). Then the stance aura is applied; its exclusiveGroup 'warrior_stance' removes the previous stance. Stance abilities share cooldownGroup 'warrior_stance' (1 s), i.e. at most one stance change per turn. Abilities whose requires.casterAuras lists stance auras are unusable in other stances. The Tactical Mastery passive has no other effect.

Damage-effect modifier. Cost 15 rage (after Improved Execute CostFlat) is paid normally; because cost.consumeAll is set, ALL rage left after paying is also spent: bonus = extraRage x 3 x rankNumber (rankNumber = 1..5 = index of the highest known rank in rankLevels + 1, i.e. 3/6/9/12/15 damage per rage). Damage = rand(min,max) + perLevel x (effLevel - learnLevel) + bonus, resolved as a normal melee special attack (miss/dodge/parry/block, crit x2 + Impale, armor). The rage is lost even if the attack misses.

Talent passive: while the warrior has warrior_defensive_stance_aura, ThreatGenerated +3% per rank (pct stat, stacking additively with the stance's +30%: x1.30 -> up to x1.45). No effect in other stances.
Talent passive: the flat bonus of warrior_cleave's WeaponDamage effect (min/max + perLevel part, not the weapon roll) is multiplied by (1 + value x rank / 100), value = 40 -> +40/80/120%.

Effect special (target Self): the caster loses health equal to 16% of its class base health at its current level (baseHealth linearly interpolated between baseHealthLevel1 and baseHealthLevel60). The loss is not mitigated (armor, absorbs, DamageTaken), cannot crit, generates no rage and no threat, and cannot reduce health below 1. Bloodrage is usable at any health above 1.

Talent passive: whenever a hostile aura imposing the Stun state (or a charm/mind-control effect) would be applied to the warrior, roll value x rank % (3/6/9/12/15); on success the aura is resisted (emit a Resist combat event).

Aura special. On apply: removes the owner's auras whose states include Fear, Incapacitate or Sleep (Sap, Gouge, Intimidating Shout, Psychic Scream...). While active: hostile auras imposing Fear, Incapacitate or Sleep are not applied (immune, emit Immune event), and rage generated by taking damage is doubled (2 x the normal 2.5 x d / c). Equivalent to ImmunityFromTags for its tags ImmuneFear/ImmuneIncapacitate plus the rage rule.

Aura special: while the aura is active its owner is immune to the unit states named by the aura's tags: 'ImmuneFear' -> Fear, 'ImmuneIncapacitate' -> Incapacitate and Sleep, 'ImmuneStun' -> Stun, 'ImmuneRoot' -> Root. Hostile auras imposing such a state are not applied (emit Immune), and existing ones are removed when this aura is applied.

specials.usedBy: ApplyAura effects of warrior_battle_shout, warrior_demoralizing_shout, warrior_sunder_armor, warrior_fury_enrage, warrior_fury_flurry, rogue_slice_and_dice, rogue_expose_armor, rogue_sprint, rogue_remorseless_attacks, poison applications (rogue)
specials.behaviour: Modifier on an ApplyAura effect (generic, used to scale aura stat amounts by rank, combo points or talent rank). The aura is applied normally, then its FIRST stat mod (mods[0]) is replaced for this aura instance by sign(mods[0].value) x M, where M = rand(min,max) + perLevel x D + (perCombo + amount x D) x CP, where D = effLevel - learnLevel of the ability that applies it (effLevel = level of the highest rank known, or caster level for scaleWithLevel), CP = combo points spent by the ability (0 for non-finishers), and inside a talent Proc passive D = talentRank - 1; then M is multiplied by (1 + sum of the casting ability's AbilityMod 'Effect' %/100). Other mods are unchanged. Stacking auras (Sunder Armor) use the newest M for every stack. Description token {n} for this effect shows M.

specials.usedBy: ApplyAura effects of warrior_thunder_clap, rogue_sap, rogue_kidney_shot
specials.behaviour: Modifier on an ApplyAura effect: the applied aura's duration (seconds) = M, where M = rand(min,max) + perLevel x D + (perCombo + amount x D) x CP, where D = effLevel - learnLevel of the ability that applies it (effLevel = level of the highest rank known, or caster level for scaleWithLevel), CP = combo points spent by the ability (0 for non-finishers), and inside a talent Proc passive D = talentRank - 1; then M is multiplied by (1 + sum of the casting ability's AbilityMod 'Effect' %/100); then AbilityMod Duration (seconds) and DurationPct apply as usual. Description token {n} shows M.

specials.usedBy: Threat effects of warrior_heroic_strike, warrior_sunder_armor, warrior_revenge, rogue_feint
specials.behaviour: Modifier on a Threat effect: instead of the flat 'threat' field, the effect adds M threat on the ability's target, where M is computed like a damage magnitude: rand(min,max) + perLevel x (effLevel - learnLevel), x (1 + AbilityMod Effect %/100). M is then multiplied by the caster's ThreatGenerated modifiers. If the effect's 'threat' field is negative (Feint) M is SUBTRACTED from the caster's threat on every enemy engaged with it (floor 0) and ThreatGenerated is not applied. Bonus threat is only added if the ability hit (not on miss/dodge/parry).

Aura special: while active, every melee hit by the owner on its target (auto attacks and single-target melee abilities; NOT area abilities such as Whirlwind/Cleave, not periodic damage) also deals the same final damage (after the primary target's mitigation, no new roll) to one other enemy within 8 yards of the primary target (nearest first). If the aura has charges, each extra hit consumes one charge and the aura ends at 0.

Talent passive restricted to weapon types listed in its 'tags' (WeaponType names, plus 'OneHanded' = any one-handed melee weapon and 'TwoHanded' = any two-handed melee weapon). (a) If 'stat' is set: the stat mod (value x rank or values[rank-1], pct flag) applies only to attacks made with a weapon of a listed type, judged per hand (an off-hand dagger gets Dagger Specialization even with a main-hand sword); for attacks not made with a weapon the main hand decides. (b) If 'proc' is set: the proc behaves exactly like a Proc passive (chance = values[rank-1] when values is given) but only triggers on hits made with a weapon of a listed type. Extra attacks granted by a proc (Sword Specialization WeaponDamage effect = one extra main-hand swing, which can be dodged/parried/crit) cannot themselves trigger the same proc.
Talent passive: damage of off-hand weapon hits (auto attacks and off-hand WeaponDamage) is multiplied by (1 + value x rank / 100), applied on top of the normal 50% off-hand penalty.

Ability special for warrior/rogue ranged attacks. Time cost = equipped ranged weapon speed / (1 + RangedHaste%/100) instead of the GCD (overflow becomes time debt like other instants). Abilities tagged 'Thrown' require a ranged weapon of type Thrown; abilities tagged 'Shoot' require Bow, Gun or Crossbow. Performs the ability's single ranged WeaponDamage hit: ranged attack power (Agi + level - 10 for Warrior and Rogue), Physical, can miss or be dodged (not parried/blocked), uses RangedHit/RangedCrit, crit x2. No ammo is consumed. Not an auto-repeat attack.
Modifier on a WeaponDamage/Damage effect: the attack cannot be dodged, parried or blocked (it can still miss and crit).
